title: Young D.C. players: Frank Wess, Dude Brown and John Malachi's little band
summary: Phillips says Frank Wess came from Oklahoma to Howard and played with Coleridge Davis, and that he gave Dude Brown his first job in 1936 from Malachi's youth band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Didn't John have a little band at one time with Frank Wess in it? Some little old band that he played around town with?
Yeah, they had a little that rehearsed around here in the 30's -- '35, like that.
When did Wess come to town?
Wess been here and lived here.
He's from out West, though, originally.

Yeah, he came here. He went to school here. He went to Howard. His stepfather was Chiropodous(?). They moved here. Frank Wess came here from Oklahoma, and he came here and he was... He played around here. Then he first got a good start playing with the band I was with, Coleridge Davis. They'd go up Atlantic City, up to Club Harlem.
How about Dude Brown? When did you first run into Dude
Phillips - 174
Brown? George Brown.
Oh man. I gave him his first job.
When was that?
Was he playing anything before that? Was he jamming with people or anything?

Yeah, he was playing. He was playing in that little band that John had. That little band, you know, that all the young boys were in. Frank Wess and John, and they had another little alto player in there (he died) named Gip Gibson...
What was his first name?
I don't know what his first name was. We called him Gip, a nickname.
He's not that alto player who was in the picture of the band with Charlie Rouse, was he?

Oh no, not him. He was way ahead of them. Curtis was. He was way ahead of John then. See, John was coming in way behind me; I mean, the guys that I was playing with. Let me see who else was in that band. Another trumpet player named Chops.
Are you talking about John's little band?
The little band John had.
You're talking about in the mid-30's.
Phillips - 175
Before he got playing a whole lot regularly.
